exam.title: Designing and Implementing Cloud-Native Applications Using Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB
exam.study_prerequisites: Application development in C# or Java, JSON, the Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL query language and SDK, PowerShell, and Azure resource-management fundamentals.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Integrate an Azure Cosmos DB solution
Optimize an Azure Cosmos DB solution
Maintain an Azure Cosmos DB solution

review.notes: All five July 21, 2026 objective groups and every published subobjective are mapped to access-pattern decisions, implementation boundaries, evidence, failure actions, three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs and 30 original knowledge checks. All 76 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries: 73 were reachable and three O'Reilly/Udemy pages were access-blocked; no cited page was missing or broken. The guide covers document modeling and versioning, natural/synthetic/hierarchical partitioning, throughput, current SDK/query/transaction/server-side patterns, regions/consistency/conflicts, Fabric mirroring and transitional Synapse analytical paths, replay-safe change feed, indexing/cache optimization, observability, backup/PITR, layered security, data movement, and IaC. It explicitly records that Synapse Link is unsupported for new projects while retaining the still-published existing-deployment objectives and directs new analytical designs to Fabric mirroring. No upcoming blueprint change or exam retirement was announced.

findings.title: Prepare for the October blueprint without replacing July early
findings.evidence: Live page now presents October 6 scope with C#/Python, retrieval, memory and new operational features.
findings.recommendation: Map all 56 future objectives and expand transition teaching; retain dated July snapshot and activation follow-up.
findings.resolution: Map all 56 future objectives and expand transition teaching; retain dated July snapshot and activation follow-up.

findings.title: Latest-version mode can bootstrap existing items
findings.evidence: It supports a beginning position, but not deleted/intermediate history; all-versions-and-deletes has different start/retention constraints.
findings.recommendation: Correct schema-migration/data-movement text and explain processor versus pull and mode selection.
findings.resolution: Correct schema-migration/data-movement text and explain processor versus pull and mode selection.

findings.title: TTL query visibility and physical deletion are separate
findings.evidence: Expired items stop appearing in query responses before eventual background deletion; serverless deletion is charged.
findings.recommendation: Clarify expiration behavior and add answer checkpoints.
findings.resolution: Clarify expiration behavior and add answer checkpoints.

findings.title: Continuation tokens do not expire with the same SDK version
findings.evidence: Page explicitly documents same-SDK nonexpiration and possible empty result pages.
findings.recommendation: Replace generic expiration warning with query/scope and SDK compatibility checks.
findings.resolution: Replace generic expiration warning with query/scope and SDK compatibility checks.

findings.title: Masked reads do not prove secrecy across every operation
findings.evidence: Current docs retain originals, describe unmask permissions and expose limitations for writes, inference, change feed and downstream copies.
findings.recommendation: Add role/operation boundary example and a negative-test matrix.
findings.resolution: Add role/operation boundary example and a negative-test matrix.

findings.title: Vector-index scope is distinct from authorization
findings.evidence: Sharding targets a subset of the index; application identity and data authorization remain separate.
findings.recommendation: Add colliding-thread tenant example, forged-scope test and current HPK support qualification.
findings.resolution: Add colliding-thread tenant example, forged-scope test and current HPK support qualification.

findings.title: Launch examples are not a current execution contract
findings.evidence: Current kit structure and SDK rules have evolved; launch blog includes a constructor syntax error and overbroad partitioning claim.
findings.recommendation: Qualify blog and teach revision-pinned proposal review with measurable acceptance tests.
findings.resolution: Qualify blog and teach revision-pinned proposal review with measurable acceptance tests.

findings.title: Backlog recovery depends on net processing capacity
findings.evidence: A continuing stream adds new work during backlog processing; a gross-rate estimate understates recovery.
findings.recommendation: Correct the formula and add synthetic 6000/(1000-400) example with equal-rate non-drain case.
findings.resolution: Correct the formula and add synthetic 6000/(1000-400) example with equal-rate non-drain case.
